note: Latent correlations between leg types (tetrachoric, on over-our-projection indicators). Leg names: role_stat from one team's view; OPP_ = the opponent. Under = flip the sign of that leg's correlations. Validated: pairwise Gaussian copula with these tables reproduced held-out NFL 3-5 leg stack hit rates within about 3% (copula_test). Built 2026-10-17.

SOCCER.note: F_=favourite, D_=underdog; corners/cards over = above the all-match median (10 corners, 4 card points)

shifts_note: Pre-game conditions that move how often a leg beats our projection (2016-25 NFL, 2025-26 NBA, NHL, MLB 2021-25). Apply: p_over_adj = Phi(Phi^-1(p_over) + sum of dz for active conditions), capped at +/-0.3. Kept only effects with the same sign in both halves and |z|>=3; dz shrunk by the share that survived out of sample. Conditions change hit rates but NOT how legs move together (tested: about as many correlation changes as random labels give).

tail_factor.note: multiply the copula joint for 3+ leg stacks: symmetric copula slightly overstates all-over stacks; all-under stacks run at or a bit above it
